role: Fallback time-asleep estimate from overnight recording length alone (90% if > 180 min, else 85%), shared by the Overnight screen (OvernightChartsView+Stats.swift:530) and the Overnight PDF (OvernightReportRenderer+Sections.swift:472).

units.does: Clamps recordingMinutes to >= 0 and sets asleepMinutes = Int(minutes * share), share 0.90 when minutes > 180 else 0.85 (truncated toward zero).
Asleep minutes as percent of recording minutes; 0 for an empty recording. Because both are derived from the fixed share it is always ~85 or ~90 (minus truncation).

flags.text: efficiencyPercent is by construction the fixed share (~85 or ~90%) of an estimate, yet OvernightChartsView passes it as OvernightStats.sleepEfficiency, whose declaration says it is nil when the night's wake was not measured; the type doc claims nothing is invented for a recording-length estimate.
